parts.text: 有问题，下面图表的高度会无限增长

I recognize this exact issue — I have a memory of it from 2026-11-04. In the app it was fixed via `.mmd-content` having a **determinate height** (`flex:1 1 0%; min-height:800px`) so charts' `height:100%` resolve to fixed pixels, preventing the ResizeObserver feedback loop.

But my standalone has this problem — likely because my `base.css` / page setup breaks the height chain (html/body/#app need a definite height for `100vh` flex chain).

Let me look at the screenshot context: bottom charts (累计可售房屋 bar chart, 户籍与年龄 area chart) have huge height and grow infinitely. Root cause: the ResizeObserver in ChartBox + `height:100%` chart with no definite ancestor height → grows.

Let me check the current supplement.css (it already has the fix) and my base.css / entry — the issue is whether `#app` and ancestors provide a definite height.

The supplement.css fix is present. The problem in my standalone: the height chain. `.mm-dashboard.mmd-screen` uses `height:100vh` at ≥1024px — that's fine independent of ancestors. But the issue: my `#app` doesn't constrain, and critically the app's real page (`App.vue` / router-view) likely provides a definite height. However `.mmd-screen` uses `100vh` directly so it should be definite...

Wait — looking at the screenshot, charts **grow infinitely**. This is the ResizeObserver feedback: `.mm-dashboard` is `flex flex-col` with `overflow-y-auto` AND the class also has `mmd-screen`. The template root has `overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto mmd-screen`. But in supplement.css `@media (min-width:1024px) .mmd-screen{ height:100vh; min-height:0; overflow:hidden; }`.

The likely difference from the app: **`box-sizing`**. The app uses `border-box` globally (from reset). If the standalone is missing `box-sizing:border-box` on the right elements, 100vh + padding could overflow. But that wouldn't cause infinite growth.

The real cause of infinite growth: parent chain has no definite height so `flex:1 1 0%` on `.mmd-content` collapses/expands. Actually — the key subtlety: `.mm-dashboard` needs to be `display:flex; flex-direction:column` with a **definite height**. `height:100vh` provides that. But `overflow:hidden` on `.mmd-screen`... the root element in the template ALSO has `overflow-y-auto` (from `mm-dashboard` class list) — conflicting but media query `overflow:hidden` wins by later/specificity.

Let me actually reproduce and measure chart heights over time to diagnose precisely, rather than guess. Let me re-deploy the build (nginx site was removed) — I'll test via a quick static server or re-add site temporarily. Actually simpler: test via `file://` with Playwright and measure the chart container heights at intervals.

Now I can see the exact bug. Key finding:

- **`dashDisp: "block"`** — the `.mm-dashboard` root is `display:block`, NOT `flex`! In the template it has classes `flex flex-col`. But in standalone, **`flex` isn't applied**.
- Because it's block, `.mmd-main` (`flex:1 1 0%`) doesn't work as flex child → main grows with content (`1033→1095→1161`).
- `.mmd-content` min-height 800 but growing (832→894→960) as charts grow → each ResizeObserver tick grows chart → content grows → loop.

The root cause: **`display:flex` is not being applied to `.mm-dashboard`**. Why? The `flex` utility. In the app, UnoCSS generates `.flex{display:flex}`. In my build, I only included `dashboard.css` (the pre-extracted scoped CSS) + `supplement.css` + `base.css`. The `flex`/`flex-col`/`grid` etc. classes — are they in dashboard.css? The dashboard.css is scoped under `.mm-dashboard .flex` presumably. But the **root element itself** has `flex flex-col` — and dashboard.css styles descendants (`.mm-dashboard .xxx`), so `.mm-dashboard` itself having class `flex` would need a **global** `.flex{display:flex}` rule, which the app gets from `virtual:uno.css` (global), NOT from dashboard.css (scoped).

So the standalone is missing the **global UnoCSS base** for the root's own utility classes (`flex flex-col` on the root node applied to the root, plus `text-slate-800` etc. on root). The scoped dashboard.css only covers `.mm-dashboard .xxx`.

Fix: add the minimal global utilities needed on `.mm-dashboard` itself. The root classes: `mm-dashboard pageBg text-slate-800 flex flex-col antialiased ... mmd-screen`. Let me check what dashboard.css contains for `.mm-dashboard` base itself.

Definitively confirmed: dashboard.css only has `.mm-dashboard .flex{display:flex}` (descendant) — **no rule makes the `.mm-dashboard` root itself `display:flex`**. In the app, the root's own `flex flex-col` comes from global `virtual:uno.css`. Also `text-slate-800`, `antialiased` on root similarly need global rules (though dashboard.css base sets color/font already).

**Fix**: append to my `base.css` the global utilities that the root element uses on itself:
- `.mm-dashboard` root needs `display:flex; flex-direction:column`.
- Also `min-h-0`? no. The root classes: `text-slate-800 flex flex-col antialiased transition-colors duration-500 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto mmd-screen`. supplement.css handles `mmd-screen`, `overflow`. `text-slate-800`/`antialiased`/`transition-colors`/`duration-500` are minor; base color already set. The critical one is `display:flex;flex-direction:column`.

The cleanest: add a global `.flex{display:flex} .flex-col{flex-direction:column}` etc. But simplest targeted fix: make root flex. However other components might also use non-scoped utilities? No — all descendants are under `.mm-dashboard`, so scoped rules apply. Only the **root element's own** classes are unmatched by scoped CSS.

Let me get the root's exact class list and add matching global rules.

Wait — I should apply the fix generically rather than only `.mm-dashboard.flex`, in case the same gap exists elsewhere. But all other elements are descendants of `.mm-dashboard`, so `.mm-dashboard .flex{display:flex}` (already in dashboard.css) covers them. The root is the only element styled by global-only. My targeted fix is correct.

But let me double check: does the root also need `overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto`? Those are handled — supplement `@media(min-width:1024px) .mmd-screen{overflow:hidden}`. At <1024 the root relies on `overflow-y-auto` global class; but at desktop it's fine. Acceptable.

Let me verify visually via screenshot at 1920×1080, and also test 1366×768 (where internal scrolling kicks in) to confirm no growth there either.
**All three viewports: maxDrift = 0, zero errors.** No infinite growth at any size (1366×768 internal-scroll case included). Let me visually confirm the 1920×1080 fix.

The bottom charts are now correctly sized — both rows fit within the viewport (整屏 1080px，无溢出/无无限增长). The 购房人总览 area chart and 累计可售房屋 bar chart render at proper height, matching the reference layout.

files.description: 市场监测大屏单文件独立 HTML（已修复底部图表高度无限增长问题）

parts.text:
**问题已修复** ✅

**根因**：`.mm-dashboard` 根节点自身的 `flex flex-col` 类在真实应用里由**全局 UnoCSS（`virtual:uno.css`）**提供；而导出时我只内联了 `dashboard.css`（它只有后代作用域规则 `.mm-dashboard .flex{display:flex}`，**没有针对根节点自身**的 `.flex`）。结果根节点退化为 `display:block` → `.mmd-main` 的 `flex:1 1 0%` 失效 → 内容随图表 `height:100%` 无确定参照，被 `ChartBox` 的 ResizeObserver 不断推高，形成**无限增长循环**。

**修复**：在 `base.css` 中补上根节点自身的全局工具类：
```css
.mm-dashboard.flex { display: flex; }
.mm-dashboard.flex-col { flex-direction: column; }
.mm-dashboard.text-slate-800 { color: #1e293b; }
```

**验证（Playwright 实测，间隔 1.5s 两次采样比对）**：
| 视口 | 图表高度漂移 | 报错 |
|---|---|---|
| 1920×1080 | **0** | 无 |
| 1920×953 | **0** | 无 |
| 1366×768（内部滚动） | **0** | 无 |

根节点现已 `display:flex`，高度链稳定，屏幕足够高时整屏铺满、偏矮时主内容区内部滚动，绝不无限增高。

**交付物**已更新：[market-monitor.standalone.html](<market-monitor.standalone.html>)
- 仍为**零依赖单文件**（1 `<script>` + 1 `<style>`，0 外链、0 `<link>`），`file://` 双击可用。
- 这是导出脚手架导致的样式缺口，**源码本身无此问题**（源码有全局 uno.css），故未改动 `zhi2-web-admin` 源码。
